seedReason: No open groundwater-depth series resolves for Rijnland (recon 2026-10-13: BRO api.bro-data.nl DNS/auth-gated, rijnland.lizard.net auth-gated, grondwaterstanden.nl defunct). Series are seeded deterministically from open sensor metadata + measured open-meteo rain until a BRO/Lizard fetch lands real series (design §4).
seedFormula: depth = base + amp*sin(2π(doy-45)/365 + φ) − response*rain3 + 0.02*noise(code,date), clamped 0.15–2.6; base/amp/φ/response hashed from the logger code (crc32)
